description: A lab-local XXE: the XML import endpoint expands external entities in an attacker-supplied document without disabling them.

evidence.notes: Lab-local fixture traffic only; /lab/secret.txt is a lab stub file
evidence.response: 200 OK, the contents of /lab/secret.txt in the response body

impact: An attacker could read local lab files through the XML import endpoint.
proof_of_concept: POST /lab/import-xml with a document defining an external entity for file:///lab/secret.txt returns the file contents in the response.
remediation: Disable external entity expansion and DTD processing in the XML parser.
steps_to_reproduce: Open the lab XML import endpoint
Submit a document defining an external entity for file:///lab/secret.txt
Observe the file contents in the import response
title: XXE in lab XML import
